svg.title: Outdoor temperature and humidity during selected hours
svg.text: Mehrabad reference weather • 08:00–15:00 • all days in each solar month
Cell value: monthly mean at that hour (°C)
Cell value: monthly mean at that hour (%)
Ochre month labels: optional summer use. Calendar day counts include weekends and holidays.
Outdoor conditions at Mehrabad; these cells do not report indoor comfort or classroom temperature.
